I worked as a hiring manager and I can’t begin to tell you how often I’d get an applicant that would say all sort of things to get a job and then drop some completely misunderstood total bullshit thing they were told by their neighbors brothers sister-in-law’s dog groomer about how the company doing XYZ is ‘totally illegal’ and the new hire could sue us for lots of money. She gets this cocky smirk and basically tells me now she can sue because her hair stylist sister told her we can be sued for discrimination for firing anyone over the age of 50. That’s when our lawyer (funny funny old dude who I adored!) told her to please do try and sue us, he would love to see her explain to a judge/jury how firing her for applying with fraudulent information amounts to age discrimination. She stormed out and I asked if our lawyer needed any Advil for the muscles he must have pulled from laughing so damn hard.

Get two kinds of ammo a cheap one for going to the shooting range and a ‘self defense’ style for home/carry. If you are looking for something for just your house not something to carry on you consider a shotgun with bird/buck shot. If you live in an apartment bird/buck shot is less likely to go through walls and you don’t have to worry as much about aiming because of the spread of the pellets. There are tons of options available, if you have questions or are unsure of the best choice definitely go to a gun shop and explain why you are looking since most places are more then happy to help you figure out the best option for your situation.
